interface_name.description: Name of the virtual tunnel interface (e.g., 'fastd0').

interface_mtu.description: MTU for the tunnel interface; set to 0 for default (recommended).

listen_addrs.description: List of addresses/hosts to bind to. If non-empty, 'port' is ignored.

port.description: UDP port to listen on if no explicit listen addresses are given.

peer_discovery_methods.description: List of peer discovery methods to enable (e.g., 'static', 'dns', 'local', 'remote').

use_static_peers.description: If true, static peers are read from a file (see 'peers_file_path'). Otherwise, dynamic discovery is used.

peers_file_path.description: Path to the static peer configuration file (used if 'use_static_peers' is true).

peer_public_key_method.description: How to resolve peer public keys: 'none', 'local' (local resolver), or 'file' (load from file).

peer_public_key_file.description: Path to file containing public key mappings (used if 'peer_public_key_method' is 'file').

uplink_limit.description: Uplink bandwidth limit in kbit/s (0 = unlimited).

log_level.description: Minimum log level to emit (debug is most verbose).

peer_method_config.description: Path to method-specific config file (e.g., for remote discovery).

enable_ipv6.description: If false, disables IPv6 support on the tunnel interface.

interface_mac.description: Optional MAC address for the interface (e.g., '00:11:22:33:44:55').

interface_owner.description: Unix username to own the interface (requires root).

interface_group.description: Unix group for the interface (optional, requires 'interface_owner').

bridge_mode.description: If true, enables layer-2 bridge mode (useful for Ethernet-over-tunnel).
